  "first_3_seconds": "A furious man accuses another of selling his men to the enemy, while the accused waves his hands and denies it. The accuser then raises a red-ribboned document and says, 'And when you believed I was dead...'",
  "ending": "Lord Sterling opens the church door to flee, but a police constable is standing right outside and says, 'Going somewhere, Lord Sterling?'",
  "problems": [
    "The opening line is strong but the visual is just a close-up of a man waving his hands; the accusation is not yet tied to a clear visual stake.",
    "The middle section relies on exposition about a death register and title transfer, which may lose viewers who don't yet know the characters.",
    "The clip introduces several characters quickly (Alexander, Rupert, Sterling, Catherine) without clear visual differentiation beyond costumes, which could confuse a first-time viewer."
  ],
  "hook_score": 8,
  "cliffhanger_score": 9,
  "standalone_score": 7,
  "verdict": "post",
  "pitch": "A betrayed duke returns from the dead to expose a conspiracy, and the final shot of a fleeing lord caught by police makes you desperate to see what happens next."
